Test Case Title: TC0001_ Check notification permission prompt is displayed during first session of Hey sales app
Description: Validate When the user log in for the first time, user should be asked if they would like to allow notifications from our application on their device.
Precondition: Fresh app install; user not yet logged in
Steps:
1. Install and open the app for the first time.
2. Log in to the application.
Expected Result:
1. User should be able to Instal the app successfully
2. When the user log in for the first time, user should be asked if they would like to allow notifications from our application on their device.
Actual Result: When the user log in for the first time, user is asked if they would like to allow notifications from our application on their device.

Test Case Title: TC0002_ Check clicking on Allow in the prompt
Description: Validate App should register successfully for push notifications. User should start receiving notifications when triggered.
Steps: 1. Select Allow on the system prompt.
Expected Result: 1. App should register successfully for push notifications. User should start receiving notifications when triggered.
Actual Result: App registers successfully for push notifications. User starts receiving notifications when triggered.

Test Case Title: TC0003_ Check clicking on deny in the prompt
Description: Validate App should not receive any push notifications. No background notifications appear.
Expected Result: 1. App should not receive any push notifications. No background notifications appear.
Actual Result: App does not receive any push notifications. No background notifications appear.

Test Case Title: TC0004_ Check the permission prompt when logging in for the second time
Description: Validate Prompt should not appear again. Notification behavior should follow prior selection. [as TC0002 & TC0003]
Precondition: User has already selected “Allow” or “Deny” once
Steps:
1. Close and relaunch the app.
2. Observe whether permission prompt reappears.
Expected Result:
1. User should be able to close the app and relaunch it
2. Prompt should not appear again. Notification behavior should follow prior selection
Actual Result: Prompt does not appear again. Notification behavior follows prior selection

Test Case Title: TC0005_ Check push notification is received when learning assignment is triggered
Description: Validate Push notification should appear on device with correct title and message format as configured.
Precondition:
1. Notifications are allowed.
2. A new “Currently Learning” assignment is assigned.
Steps:
1. Log in to web app
2. Assign a learning to a learner [Who is logged out the mobile app]
3. Trigger a learning notification event.
Expected Result:
1. Admin should be able to login to web app
2. Admin should be able to assign a learning to a learner [Who has logged in the mobile app]
3. Push notification should appear on device with correct title and message format as configured.
Actual Result: Push notification appears on device with correct title and message format as configured.

Test Case Title: TC0006_ Check the deeplink behavior of push notification
Description: Validate App should open directly to the respective Learning Preview Page.
Precondition:
1. Notification received on device.
2. App is installed and user is logged in.
Expected Result: 1. App should open directly to the respective Learning Preview Page.
Actual Result: App opens directly to the respective Learning Preview Page.

Test Case Title: TC0007_ Check the deeplink behavior when user is logged out
Description: Validate Notification is not received. (Push notifications are not sent to logged-out users.)
Precondition: User is logged out of app.
Steps:
1. Log in to web app
2. Assign a learning to a learner [Who is logged out the mobile app]
3. Trigger a learning notification event.
Expected Result:
1. Admin should be able to login to web app
2. Admin should be able to assign a learning to a learner [Who has logged in the mobile app]
3. Notification should not be received. (Push notifications are not sent to logged-out users.)
Actual Result: Notification is not received. (Push notifications are not sent to logged-out users.)

Test Case Title: TC0008_ Check the app behavior after disabling notifications from system settings
Description: Validate No notification should appear on device.
Steps:
1. Navigate to device settings
2. Turn off the App Notifications
3. Log in to web app as admin
4. Assign a learning to a learner
5. Check the mobile notification
Expected Result:
1. Learner should be able to navigate to device settings
2. Learer should be able to turn off the device notification
3. Admin should be able to login to web app
4. Admin should be able to assign a learning to a learner
5. No notification should appear on device.

Test Case Title: TC0009_ Check the app behavior after re-enabling notifications from system settings
Description: Validate Push notifications should be received correctly.
Precondition: User had denied earlier and manually enabled notifications from settings.
Steps:
1. Go to phone settings → enable notifications for the app.
2. Trigger notification.
Expected Result:
1. Learer should be able to turn on the device notification
2. Push notifications should be received correctly.

Test Case Title: TC0010_ Check push notification behavior across iOS and Android
Description: Validate Notifications should be delivered and displayed correctly on both OS platforms.
Steps: 1. Trigger the same notification for test user accounts on both devices
Expected Result: 1. Notifications should be delivered and displayed correctly on both OS platforms.
Actual Result: Notifications are delivered and displayed correctly on both OS platforms.

Test Case Title: TC0011_ Check the app handling when device is offline
Description: Validate Notification should not appear if the device is offline
Precondition: User is logged in; notifications allowed.
Steps:
1. Turn off network.
2. Trigger a notification.
3. Check the notification in device
4. Turn On the network
Expected Result:
1. Learner should be able to turn off the network
2. Admin should assign a learning
3. No notifications should be displayed
4. Notification should appear once device reconnects to network
Actual Result: Notification appears once device reconnects to network

Test Case Title: TC0012_ Check the deeplink behavior for a deleted learning
Description: Validate No content error message should be displayed
Precondition: User is logged in; notifications allowed.
Steps:
1. Log in to web app
2. Assign a learning to a learner
3. Trigger a learning notification event.
4. Now delete the assigned learning in web
5. Click on the notification in mobile app
Expected Result:
1. Admin should be able to login to web app
2. Admin should be able to assign a learning to a learner [Who has logged in the mobile app]
3. Push notification should appear on device with correct title and message format as configured.
4. Admin should be able to delete the assigned learning 
5. No content error message should be displayed
Actual Result: No content error message is displayed
